prediction_text: Direction: The conference panel's consensus prediction is Hillary Clinton to win the 2016 US presidential election over Donald Trump, decided 8 November 2016 (single dated event, day scale) — i.e. the panel majority calls it for Clinton, in line with the polls.
basis:
tradition/system: not labelled on the card (no tradition/system field); system actually used: Western astrology (conference election panel consensus).
Basis: this card asks for the panel's call as a body: card facts are that most polls favour Clinton and an international astrology conference panel is forecasting the race. Panel-consensus forecasts of this kind track the conventional indicators and the majority of panellists; on the facts supplied the consensus call is Clinton. This card is kept distinct from WP-005, which isolates a single panellist with a contrary track record. No individual charts are supplied on the card.
